response.sql: WITH rating_prices AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS across_rating_average FROM rating_prices) SELECT AVG(rp.per_day_price) AS average_per_day_price, AVG(rp.per_day_price - ra.across_rating_average) AS average_excess FROM rating_prices rp CROSS JOIN rating_average ra WHERE rp.per_day_price > ra.across_rating_average
